violations.text: Bathroom located inside establishment not completely enclosed with tight-fitting, self-closing doors. Bathroom door not self closing.
Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items. Cell phone and purse stored on top of rack with food items.
Establishment charging automatic credit card fee without properly disclosing the information on the menu and the bill. Automatic credit card fee are required to be on the menu, website and receipt.
Chlorine sanitizer used to sanitize clean in place equipment not at proper minimum strength. Do not use equipment not properly sanitized. At zero ppm, corrected to 100.

Raw animal foods not properly separated from one another based upon minimum required cooking temperature when stored in a freezer - not all products commercially packaged. Raw chicken over raw pork in reach in freezer not all in original packaging.

Chemical test kit not used to ensure proper sanitization of equipment when using a chlorine chemical sanitizer. Using chlorine for sanitation bucket but only has quaternary test strips in establishment.

Exterior door has a gap at the threshold that opens to the outside.
Back door

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Hood filters

Raw animal foods not properly separated from each other in holding unit based upon minimum required cooking temperature.
Raw chicken over raw beef reach in freezer

Commercially processed ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food opened and held more than 24 hours not properly date marked after opening.
Heavy cream opened yesterday

Commercially processed reduced oxygen packaged fish bearing a label indicating that it is to remain frozen until time of use no longer frozen and not removed from reduced oxygen package.
Tilapia in bowl with ice thawing. Still frozen Educated Corrected On-SiteCorrected On-Site**

Test strips were old. Didn't work for either chlorine or quaternary. Inspectors strips worked
